prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Houston, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1159; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was backing out of a parking space at a grocery store in Houston, Texas, moving slowly with my foot on the brake, when the rear of my vehicle struck the front corner of a pickup that was pulling through the lane behind me. Neither of us was moving fast, but the impact was enough to jolt me forward against my seatbelt. I felt a sharp pain in my right shoulder almost immediately and had trouble lifting my arm for several days afterward. I have described the events the same way each time I have spoken with the store's staff, the other driver, and the adjuster, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle with the owner's permission at the time of the collision. I have kept my medical appointments and am providing the receipts and records requested.
